{/* Dialog Box */} BT's TT Academy Details
{feature1Heading}

🧠 My warm-up and cool-down exercises are uniquely designed using techniques learned from:

• NCC Army Wing Senior Under Officer ("C" Certificate Holder)

• Multi-sport experience including Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Handball, and Table Tennis

• Chinese Kung Fu (Blue Belt Holder from "Shaolin Jackie Chan Martial Arts Academy")

If you are looking to elevate your TT game, I bring a unique mix of corporate experience, sports discipline, and mentoring passion to help you reach your goals with confidence.

Training Details

First Session will be free of cost for one to one coaching as well as for Group. This is to check on expectations, skill level from both side.

1 to 1 coaching: INR 2000 for 90 minutes session.

Group coaching (5 - 8 members per batch and it will be separated as per age group):{" "} 3 sessions per week (90 minutes each session including exercises). INR 3000 per player for one month. Slot needs to be discussed and book in advance to plan my calendars. If anyone requiring a specific time outside my regular coaching hours can contact me for feasibility checks.

TT Board/Facilities to be provided by Players. I will be collecting a one-time charge of ₹300 from each player in the group for getting TT Balls and for multiball practice. This is valid for 6 months duration.

My TT Coaching Timings:

Saturday: 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM & 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM

Sunday: 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM

📞 For bookings and inquiries, please contact us via the contact form or email to btsttacademy@gmail.com.
